purpose: Off-target / anti-target selectivity panel. A repurposing hit that engages the NR4A LBDs is only a real ligand (not a universal lipophilic sticker) if it does NOT bind unrelated nuclear receptors and classic anti-targets equally well. Dock the candidate set into each panel target with the IDENTICAL smina protocol used for the NR4A dock (24 Angstrom box, exhaustiveness 8), then compare each drug's NR4A delta-G to its best off-target delta-G. Small/negative gap => promiscuous; large positive gap (off-targets weaker) => NR4A-family-preferential.

MR.title: Mineralocorticoid receptor ligand-binding domain with compuond 37a
rules: R1 the entry must reference the requested UniProt accession on a protein polymer entity
R2 X-ray diffraction (a docking box centred on a solution-NMR model's ligand has no single frame)
R3 at least one drug-like ligand by apo_pose_recovery.drug_like (MW 200-800, not an additive, not a peptide/saccharide/nucleic acid)

R4 prefer an entry whose title does NOT declare an engineered mutant (apo_pose_recovery.engineered_flag) — the MR LBD is very often deposited as the S810L mutant, and a mutant receptor is a different anti-target
R6 then lowest pdb id, purely to make the pick deterministic
